name: warehouse
title: Warehouse
summary: Physical work for Official Store stock: bins, put-away of received goods, pick waves and pick lists by order with bin locations and scanning, packing stations (item checklist, box and weight, carrier label through shipping, packing slip), shortage and damage reports, and receipt of return parcels handed over to returns inspection.
owns: Bins (zone, aisle, shelf; pick, bulk, returns, quarantine) and which stock items live in which bin
Put-away tasks for received purchase deliveries
Warehouse fulfillments: one per Official Store seller group of an accepted order, with ship-by deadline
Pick waves and pick lists grouped by order with bin locations; bin and item scanning
Packing: packages, item checklist by scan, box type, dimensions and weight, carrier label (through shipping), packing slip
Shortage and damage reports at pick and pack (resolved by inventory)
Return parcel receipt at the warehouse and hand-over to returns inspection
notOwns: Stock quantities and stock groups: inventory
Purchase orders and receiving counts: purchasing
Carriers, rates, labels' carrier accounts, tracking and dispatch exceptions: shipping
Return inspection, condition decision and refunds: returns and finance
Seller packing: sellers pack and ship their own orders at launch (seller fulfilment tasks live in orders and shipping)

stateMachines.name: Warehouse fulfillment
stateMachines.notes: startPicking when its wave starts. hold on a shortage or damage report (also one found after every line was picked, before packing starts): the order stays in the wave and is not packed partly. resume goes back to picking; lines already picked stay picked, so finishPicking follows once the replacement unit is picked. resume on inventory.discrepancy.resolved (reallocated) or by staff. cancel only when every line is cancelled (orders.item.cancelled); single cancelled lines are removed and picked units go back to their bin. dispatch on shipping.shipment.dispatched.

stateMachines.name: Package
stateMachines.notes: label requires every item scanned, a box (or dimensions) and a weight. pack hands the package to shipping for carrier pickup. voidLabel cancels the carrier label through shipping before reprinting a different service.

stateMachines.name: Wave
stateMachines.notes: complete when every fulfillment in the wave is packed, on hold or cancelled; on-hold orders move to the next wave.

stateMachines.name: Put-away task
stateMachines.notes: Created from purchasing.receipt.recorded per received line (excluding damaged units, which go to a quarantine bin task).

stateMachines.name: Return parcel
stateMachines.notes: Expected parcels come from returns.return.approved for Official Store returns. A parcel with no matching return is created directly as received with unexpected = true. Hand-over moves it to the inspection bench; returns owns inspection from there.

consumes.name: orders.order.accepted
consumes.does: Create a fulfillment for each Official Store group and each Fulfilled by Marketly group (fulfilledBy marketly_service; at fulfillment-service.getServiceLocation, else the default location; seller stored). Lines carry stock item ids from the purchase snapshot and ship-by from shipping

consumes.name: orders.item.split
consumes.does: A line was split (partial cancel, shipment or return; decision S-D1): split the fulfillment line of itemId so newItemId gets its own line with quantity units (picked units stay on the original line first), so later cancel and dispatch events that name either item find their line. Idempotent per newItemId

consumes.name: orders.item.cancelled
consumes.does: Cancel the line; if already picked, return units to the bin; if packed, flag the package to be reopened

consumes.name: inventory.discrepancy.resolved
consumes.does: Resume a held fulfillment when the shortage or damage was reallocated

consumes.name: purchasing.receipt.recorded
consumes.does: Create put-away tasks for received units (damaged units to a quarantine bin)

consumes.name: fulfillment-service.inbound.received
consumes.does: Create put-away tasks for a Fulfilled by Marketly receiving record like a purchase receipt: sellable units (received − damaged) to the suggested bin, damaged units to quarantine; receipt_id = receiptId, receipt_ref = the IB- ref, location = locationId. Idempotent per receiptId

consumes.name: returns.return.approved
consumes.does: Expect a return parcel when the return goes to a Marketly warehouse (Official Store returns and Fulfilled by Marketly returns, fulfilledBy marketly_service)

consumes.name: shipping.shipment.dispatched
consumes.does: Mark packages and the fulfillment dispatched

consumes.name: shipping.dispatch.overdue
consumes.does: Raise the fulfillment to the top of the pick list and flag it

SCAN_MISMATCH.meaning: Scanned bin or item does not match the line. details.expected, details.scanned

FULFILLMENT_ON_HOLD.meaning: The order is on hold for a shortage or damage; do not pack it partly

DISCREPANCY_OPEN.meaning: Inventory has not resolved the shortage or damage yet

PACKAGE_INCOMPLETE.meaning: Not every item is scanned, or box/weight is missing. details.missing

LABEL_REQUIRED.meaning: The package has no valid label

LABEL_FAILED.meaning: The carrier did not return a label. 502 when it could not be reached (retry with the same Idempotency-Key); 422 when it refused the parcel or service (change them), as shipping answers. details.carrierMessage

SERVICE_BREAKS_PROMISE.meaning: That carrier service arrives after the date the customer was promised

BIN_CODE_TAKEN.meaning: A bin with this code already exists at the location

BIN_NOT_EMPTY.meaning: Bin still has stock items assigned

PARCEL_ALREADY_RECEIVED.meaning: This return parcel was already received. details.parcelId

notes: Event consumers and once-only jobs are idempotent through the kernel inbox (ctx.mongo.claim), never through scan_log rows: orders.item.cancelled claims item-cancelled:<cancellationId>, shipping.dispatch.overdue claims dispatch-overdue:<exceptionId> and the at-risk job claims at-risk:<fulfillmentId>. scan_log stays a troubleshooting and productivity log.

Scope is Official Store and Fulfilled by Marketly groups. Other outside sellers pick and pack their own orders; their tasks and shipments are in orders and shipping. Fulfilled by Marketly (fulfillment-service, phase 4) reuses fulfillments, waves and packing for seller-owned stock at the service location: the label is bought from the service location's address and billed to the seller (shipping.createLabel billedTo seller, decision D1), the packing slip reads 'Sold by <seller> · Fulfilled by Marketly', warehouse.package.packed carries the seller as owner, and serials are recorded as for Official lines. Every consumer that used to skip non-official groups (item cancelled, dispatch overdue, shipment dispatched, return parcels) finds its fulfilment by seller_group_id, so a missing row is the only filter. Put-away also covers Fulfilled by Marketly receiving records (fulfillment-service.inbound.received). Physical removal orders stay staff-handled for now (decision D9).

Mixed orders: a fulfillment covers only one Official Store or Fulfilled by Marketly seller group. The packing slip lists only those items and says which package number it is and that other packages ship separately.
Labels are bought through shipping (shipping.createLabel with the package, the delivery choice and an idempotency key); warehouse never talks to carriers directly.

Shortage and damage at pick/pack create inventory discrepancies; inventory decides (reallocate from another bin or Returned, or adjust). Damaged reserved units move to Damaged or held in inventory immediately.

Return receipt: warehouse scans the parcel in and hands it over; returns owns inspection, condition and outcome proposal; inventory records the stock outcome; finance approves refunds. Receiving calls returns.recordWarehouseReceipt in-process (returns publishes returns.return.received); warehouse.return_parcel.received is for work queues and reports.

Receiving labels (GET /putaway-tasks/labels) are rendered here from the put-away tasks of a purchasing receipt: SKU barcode, product label and suggested bin. Carrier service options at packing come from shipping.quoteLabelOptions, so the rule 'only services that keep the customer's promise' is the same one updatePackage enforces.
Bins live here; inventory keeps quantities per location (site) and shows the primary bin code it learns from warehouse.bin.assigned.

Damage photos (DamageReport.photoIds) and return parcel photos are attached with media.attach (usage kind inspection_photo, refId the fulfillment or parcel id) before they are passed on, so the media orphan sweep never deletes them; inventory attaches the same photos to its discrepancy.
Item scans match the SKU label or the variant GTIN (inventory.getStockItems returns gtin from catalog).
